notes.turkish: Not fine enough for Turkish coffee.

rangeInfo.note: Honest Coffee Guide's chart (community, not the manufacturer's): espresso 0–7, moka pot 7–18, AeroPress 5–30, V60 8–20, filter coffee machine 4–28, French press 20–40, cold brew 24–40. Its V60 row is used for pour-over, “Filter Coffee Machine” for drip, French press for immersion. Baratza doesn't recommend the Virtuoso+ for espresso machines.
rangeInfo.estimateNote: Estimated by extrapolating the cited ranges, not from the source: Rapid Brewer: from the middle of the AeroPress range to the middle of the pour-over range. Dial in from there.
